dataset.name: Local resource inventory and solver-neutral coupling freeze
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V10M. Inventory the current Windows host, CPU, memory, GPU, writable storage and exact candidate executable files without installing software or launching a solver. Reverify selected cached impact, thermal, structural and visualization anchors. Freeze a solver-neutral coupling graph with units, mappings, uncertainty variables, validation gates, runtime classes and stop criteria from impact through separately modeled propagation/arrest and Blender visualization. Do not assign new physical properties, close any of the 22 mechanical source requirements, execute a solver, launch Blender, modify the protected Blender master, or infer real-event probabilities from synthetic ensembles.

gates.gate_interpretation: Software availability is sufficient for the next bounded integration step, but no unavailable input or failed physical gate is closed by executable presence.

epistemic_separation.observed_facts: Hardware, declared-path presence, executable metadata/hashes and cached artifact identities.
epistemic_separation.official_model_results: Preserved as dependent inputs only when referenced by cached modules.
epistemic_separation.archive_claims: No source archive read or promoted in V10N.
epistemic_separation.model_hypotheses: Reduced fields, reconstructed topology and future interface scenarios remain labelled hypotheses.
epistemic_separation.derived_results: Resource sufficiency for short controls and the frozen coupling contracts.
epistemic_separation.unknowns: Physical impact damage, exact fire/thermal interfaces, 22 mechanical requirements, initiation and propagation validation.

next_iteration.objective: Implement schema-validated adapters for the frozen reduced-order coupling interfaces, replay the shortest cached baseline cases, and produce the first integrated no-propagation control without launching a multi-hour solve.
